meta.dashboardTitle: Bowers Frontier Institute | BR3N Credit Collar Feed

hero.title: Macro command for currency, risk, and capital decisions.
hero.copy: A luxury-grade finance cockpit for market oversight, credit-collar discovery, rates, volatility, drawdown, and hedge posture. Fast, intentional, and calm.

disclosure.footer: Research only. Delayed and mock data are used throughout this dashboard; nothing here is investment advice, trade execution, or a recommendation for any account.

research.title: Pre-registered hypotheses and verdicts
research.lede: Holdout results from Bowers Frontier Institute labs. Falsified hypotheses stay on the board. This page does not place orders, hold funds, call exchange APIs, or emit trading signals.

error.title: Dashboard unavailable. Refresh to retry.
error.researchOnly: Research only. Nothing here executes trades.

dashboard.modularDataCopy: Mock files are separated by FX, performance, exposure, rates, volatility, and correlations for live API replacement.

pwa.title: Install BR3N Collars
pwa.lead: Add BR3N Collars to your home screen.
pwa.ios: On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen for a standalone app experience.
pwa.android: Install the app for a full-screen dashboard, fast reloads, and offline shell support.

collars.title: Mobile feed for positive-credit downside hedges.
collars.copy: Ranks collars by received credit, protected floor, liquidity, and upside room. Built for owned-stock or ETF hedging research, not uncovered call selling.
collars.noticeUnavailable: Live feed unavailable — showing the verified snapshot fallback.
collars.noticePartial: Live feed is partial — showing verified snapshot coverage where needed.
collars.empty: No positive-credit structures passed the current filter. Widen the universe or select a different optimization profile.
collars.disclaimer: Research candidates only. Quotes can move quickly; validate live bid/ask, tax impact, assignment risk, and portfolio fit before acting.

trades.title: BR3N Credit Collar Trades
trades.heading: Trade board that loads on iPhone.
trades.intro: Positive-credit collar candidates using conservative pricing: sell call at bid, buy put at ask. These are research candidates for owned shares or ETFs, not trade instructions.
trades.notice: Collars cap upside and can create assignment/tax considerations. Validate live quotes and suitability before entering anything. This page is a mobile preview and research board only.
